serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
It’s time to send Big Daddy all the blog posts and chat messages…
With them he’s supposed to come up with some plan to stop them.
I wonder though what exactly Admin’s game plan is. 
He said he had nothing to do with the assassination of neither the anti-sexbot activist nor member of the House, but many people are already thinking otherwise, even in his blog’s comment section…
I’m also concerned with Big Daddy’s attitude. He didn’t seem shook at all about the fact that we could have prevented one of these deaths, but chose not to.
I feel like there are some things that I still don’t know.
I wonder if I did the right thing…
Anyway, I should probably go to see Big Daddy soon. With all this data I’m sure he will come up with some sort of plan.
